audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers handed Lucian rows 0-5 and only 'Skill' at two items, on a lane whose own prose says everything flips at 6. The packet chart reads Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin. diff was also 'HARD' while diffRating, tone and both rating lines say Favoured.
audit.why: Riftwalk is a 500-range blink on a 5/3.5/2s cooldown; once it is online Lucian cannot hold him at range, and Rod of Ages outpaces a weak-scaling ADC's first item. The mirror flagged this same disagreement but was blocked by its own length band.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin in both layers as matched pairs, ratings re-scaled 8/8/5/4/3/3/2, and diff changed HARD to FAV so it agrees with diffRating 4/10 and 'Favoured matchup'.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] described level 6 as Lucian's spike ('The Culling adds lane-clear') on a lane where 6 is Kassadin's spike; phases[5] called first item Lucian's kill window.
audit.why: Riftwalk at 6 is the single largest swing in the matchup, and Kassadin's first-item Rod of Ages spike beats Lucian's.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states Riftwalk's 500 range and 5s cooldown plus the Null Sphere silence; phases[5].why names the Rod of Ages spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] and the 'late' block both claim Kassadin's 'anti-AP shield eats The Culling'. Null Sphere's shield absorbs MAGIC damage and Void Stone reduces magic damage — The Culling is physical, so neither touches it. Separately, Nether Blade (W) is an auto-attack reset and was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere text: 'a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage'. Void Stone: 'takes reduced magic damage'. Lucian's R deals physical damage, so telling a player his ult is absorbed is a false read that will make them decline a winnable execute.
audit.corrected: The false anti-magic claim removed from whys[6] and 'late'; the real reasons (blink out, silence mid-string, HP pool) kept. Nether Blade's auto-reset wind-up added to the interactions row as the step-back cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Don't #1 was generic filler with no numbers.
audit.why: Null Sphere is 650 range against Lucian's 500 Q and shields on cast.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the range comparison and the shield.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: His Q shield and Force Pulse let him farm through poke now — keep shoving, but stop overcommitting at melee.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Riftwalk — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Null Sphere's shield and his rising sustain pull 4-5 back his way — trade on his 7s Q cooldown, never on yours.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Riftwalk is a 500-range blink on a 5s cooldown and Null Sphere silences your casts — his all-in beats yours.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Rod of Ages outpaces your first item as a weak-scaling ADC — stop dueling him and cash the lead into towers.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Two-item Kassadin blinks past your kite and Null Sphere silences your combo — concede the 1v1 and play with your team.

edits.before: Track Kassadin’s Riftwalk: His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Riftwalk blinks 500 on a 5s cooldown. Null Sphere silences casts, not autos; Nether Blade (W) is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue.

edits.before: That’s Kassadin’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Null Sphere out-ranges your Q 650 to 500 and shields him for the trade back.

edits.before: Two-item Kassadin blinks past your kite, silences your combo, and his anti-AP shield eats The Culling — concede the 1v1 and let your lead carry.
edits.after: Two-item Kassadin blinks past your kite and Null Sphere silences your combo mid-string — concede the 1v1 and let your early lead carry the map.

edits.before: This is Kassadin's game and you know it — he is a hard scaler and you are a weak one. Once Rod of Ages and Rylai's are online his Riftwalk stacks let him blink past your kite, his Q silences your double-shots, and his anti-AP shield means even your The Culling channel struggles to execute him. Don't 1v1 a 2-item Kassadin. Your only path is the lead you built levels 2-6: take towers, roam, and end the game before his items come online.
edits.after: This is Kassadin's game and you know it — he is a hard scaler and you are a weak one. Once Rod of Ages and Rylai's are online his Riftwalk stacks let him blink past your kite, his Q silences your double-shots mid-string, and his shield plus that HP pool means your burst no longer kills before he blinks out. Don't 1v1 a 2-item Kassadin. Your only path is the lead you built levels 2-6: take towers, roam, and end the game before his items come online.
